text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah got injured during training, 
so I rushed over to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I am deeply sorry.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...No. It is not about that. It is about 
what I am going to say next.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I know I'm asking for the 
impossible. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Could you... let me train?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I watched the footage of my mother over 
and over. That is precisely why I—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to halt all the efforts
we've 
built up until now... Not over something 
like this.

text_block_list.text:
I don't want to halt all the efforts
we've 
built up until now... Not over something 
like this.
choice_data_list: You need to be resting right now.
You really should be resting right...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Still.
choice_data_list: You need to be resting right now.
You really should be resting right...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—...gh... Thank you very much... You 
are... absolutely right.
choice_data_list: Overdoing it can end up destroying...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
What's important is making a full 
recovery... For now,
I'll focus completely 
on that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah obediently dedicated herself 
to resting.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It felt like my legs were dragging a 
little. ...I'll call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you very much for indulging my 
selfishness."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah's injury has worsened. It was 
decided that she should take some time
off 
to rest immediately.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
There is no problem.
There's no particular 
pain, either.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much for giving 
your permission.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let us continue at this pace, one step at 
a time, marching forward with courage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah continued light training
after 
that, and before long, she was making a 
smooth comeback.
